bind_structured_output: bind an LLM to a Pydantic schema for structured output with automatic fallback to free text
invoke_structured_call: invoke a structured LLM call and render the result to markdown with free-text fallback on failure
create_structured_agent: create an agent that uses structured output binding for typed Pydantic responses from an LLM
build_fallback_pattern: build a graceful fallback pattern that retries a failed structured LLM call as plain free text
review_structured_output: review the structured output binding and invocation pattern for agent reliability and error handling
